title: Abba Elazar
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: Mentioned in Chagigah 16b and at the beginning of Sifra, Vayikra, chapter 2: Rabbi Yose said, “Abba Elazar told me”—Rashi explains that this was his name—“once we had a calf for a peace offering,” etc. Hyman infers that he had seen the Temple while it still stood.

notes.text: “While the Temple stood” renders בבניינו. The inference that he saw it is Hyman’s.
The consulted Chagigah passage supports the calf narrative. The parallel Sifra and the inference about seeing the Temple remain as Hyman reports them.
